short: Extraordinary mechanical properties of AZ61 alloy processed
title: Extraordinary mechanical properties of AZ61 alloy processed by ECAP with 160 degree channel angle and EPT

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Wrought Mg alloys trade strength against ductility; AZ61 needs both without rare-earth additions. Storing dislocations by low-strain ECAP and then recrystallising them statically with a short electropulse should give ultrafine equiaxed grains with strength and ductility together.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/route), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/treatment), n7a (PRC/treatment), n9 (DES/down_select), n7 (PRC/treatment), n8 (PRC/treatment)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Single-temperature ECAP gives either an underdeformed billet that fractures by the fifth pass at 373 K or a dynamically recrystallised structure at 423-473 K. After variable-temperature ECAP the grains are refined but elongated and not equiaxed, so dynamic recrystallisation is incomplete.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (STR/microstructure/shape), n12 (STR/microstructure/shape), n13 (STR/defect/extended), n14 (STR/microstructure/feature_size), n15 (STR/microstructure/orientation)

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The ECAP temperature sets a balance: too low and the billet cannot take the strain, too high and dynamic recrystallisation consumes the stored energy. Yield strength 330 MPa and tensile strength 448 MPa, against 100 and 260 MPa as received.
states.detail: Absorbed: n10 (MEC/pathway), n16 (PRP/value), n17 (PRP/value), n18 (MEC/tradeoff). Premises: A 160 deg ECAP die imposes only about 0.2 equivalent strain per pass, far less than a 90 deg die; A weak basal texture and a high high-angle boundary fraction let non-basal slip and boundary sliding operate, raising ductility in Mg; Electropulsing delivers a high peak current density whose electron-wind force drives dislocation motion and recrystallisation nucleation

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Variable-temperature 160 deg ECAP followed by a short electropulse gives AZ61 an ultrafine grain size with 330 MPa YS, 448 MPa UTS and 15% elongation

nodes.title: MICRO, F10, F4, F6
nodes.head: At 423 K slip and twin bands thicken from 2 to 4 passes and by 5 passes dark fine-grained recrystallised patches occupy much of the field. After 8 passes at 423 K the etched structure is fine and directional, and after 3 further passes at 373 K it is finer still and remains directional.

nodes.head: The (0001) pole figures give maxima of 3.85 mrd for the 25 us sample and 4.57 mrd for the 30 us sample, with the density concentrated off-centre toward TD. Both misorientation histograms carry a tall spike below about 3 deg plus a broad band peaking near 30 deg, which spreads out toward 90 deg for the longer pulse
nodes.solves: The recrystallised structure has a weak basal texture, maximum 3.85 mrd, and a boundary population dominated by high-angle boundaries
